policy: Escalate crop readers only for failure classes digit_crop already surfaces. Keep layout for printed fields. Fill empties only; never clobber page-text. Same schema validators as ocr/digit_crop.py + ocr/pin_master.py.

pin_locality.policy: Derive city/state from India Post PIN master; skip city/state VLM crops. Canonical = master city/state (suburb vs city mismatch is expected).

h1_address_block.note: Wider band than digit combs; use only when street/locality/city dump is empty.

notes.hardware: TrOCR/Florence-2 are the PLAN.md step-5 local path. Qwen2-VL stays last-resort / bigger machine.
notes.city_state_path: PIN recovered → lookup city/state → skip VLM. PIN missing → ink check → VLM → vocab gate. Dual-reader consensus is a later escalate, not the core fix.
notes.bakeoff: layout vs layout+digit_crop vs layout+digit_crop+crop_vlm_on_fn_only. Keep VLM only if micro-F1 rises without precision drop.
